items.summary: Recommendation: preserve the CRO plan as deferred backlog only. Retain the three evidence-backed opportunities, but reject new production work, requeues, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, spend, monetization changes, and unsupported revenue claims this cycle. Evidence: 47 failure follow-ups remain open, 28 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 2 outcomes are proven; revenue is $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 and not site-attributable. ROI, margin, and causal lift are unknown. Smallest next step: complete existing repair-or-close, measurement reconciliation, and legal/security evidence. Owner decision: after human-counsel review, authorize the prepared Woot permission request or keep it unsent.

Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and external outreach unsent. Official Woot materials establish API access mechanics, not public or commercial reuse rights; all four legal launch tasks remain open, and security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates are incomplete. No go-live or monetization proposal is supported. Continue the existing consolidated evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix.
